findings.title: Elevated host access in retained Helm test rendering

normalized_input.claimed_source: workload in a deployed probe container
normalized_input.claimed_sink: host network, PID namespace, root or procfs access
preconditions: An operator deploys the rendered workload with working images and configuration
normalized_input.impact: Elevated access to the monitored host

affected_locations.label: historical artifact
affected_locations.detail: Accurate warning in a retained synthetic rendering, not deployment approval

reachable_path: Recorded Helm test rendering uses registry.example.invalid fixture images
No cluster applied and no container started in the recorded run

boundary_assessment.policy_basis: deploy/enterprise/kubernetes/README.md and HELM_20261028T103133Z/report.json; no applicable SECURITY.md found

exploitability_stack_rank.rationale: not actionable in this exact frozen historical artifact; current deployment qualification is separate

evidence: Retained report explicitly limits execution to Helm lint/render
Fixture image registry is .invalid and both components default disabled
counterevidence: The source template retains the same elevated privileges; this is not a false warning or a safe deployment verdict
proof_gaps: Current enabled deployment remains unqualified; institution configuration, cluster isolation and independent key custody require separate review and execution
findings.recommended_next_step: Retain raw HIGH finding; classify only original artifact hash and exact location; block any new manifest finding
